text: The Commodity Exchange Act family and friends exemption allows a qualifying manager to trade options and futures for fifteen individuals who need not be sophisticated or qualified investors, which circumvents accredited investor standards and admits retail investors into hedge funds.
citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387
